first_decision_seconds_source: XPolicyLab fa431ec policy/OpenWAM/OpenWAM/benchmarks/{libero,libero-plus,robocasa365}/policy_config.yml request_timeout: 300 (single_eval.py default 300): the official OpenWAM clients' per-request allowance, which covers the first inference's warm-up. The first decision of an episode gets it; every later one decision_seconds.

action_limits.bounds_source: Boxes from pinned RoboDojo ee67a14: arm bases env_cfg/robot/dual_x5.yml (left [-0.3,-0.45,0.765], right [0.3,-0.45,0.765]); reach 0.912 m = sum of X5A.urdf joint-origin offsets base_link->link6->finger joints (all-links-straight upper bound); z from 5 cm below the table top (env_cfg/scene/default.yml: table z 0.74 + 0.025) to base + reach. Gross-error gate, not a policy constraint.

native_step_limit_source: set per task by tools/freeze_config.py from configs/robodojo-step-limits.json
method_source: OpenWAM-Alpha (official XPolicyLab adapter, unchanged) proposing every chunk through the OEH gateway: capability admission, numeric action validation against action_limits, native step and wall budgets, receipts for every native step. No LLM. The direct-condition reference of the OEH study (docs/agent-icl-study), not a leaderboard method of its own.
